units.source_text: 培卟没说话，点了只高级香烟。

en.t: Pepp said nothing and lit a high-grade cigarette.

units.source_text: 跪在地上给托喀验伤的查医生对我们五个（一个人和四只河童）大声宣告说：“药石罔顾了。

en.t: Dr. Chuck, who was kneeling on the ground examining Tock's injuries, loudly announced to the five of us (one human and four kappa): "Medicine and treatment are of no use now.

units.source_text: 托喀原来就患胃病，容易抑郁。”

en.t: Tock had already been suffering from a stomach ailment, and he was prone to depression."
